review_candidates.title: ICT System Engineer
review_candidates.description: Functieomschrijving Als ICT System Engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor het dagelijks beheer van onze IT-infrastructuur. Je zorgt ervoor dat onze systemen betrouwbaar, performant en veilig blijven functioneren. Je werkt nauw samen met collega's, leveranciers en externe partners om gebruikers optimaal te ondersteunen en projecten succesvol te realiseren. Deze functie is een mooie mix van operationele ondersteuning en projectmatig werk, waardoor je in aanraking komt met een breed scala aan technologieën en uitdagingen. Je maakt deel uit van een hecht team van vier ICT System Engineers/Administrators en rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de ICT Manager. Samen zorgen jullie ervoor dat de interne ICT-omgeving beschikbaar, veilig en up-to-date blijft. Verantwoordelijkheden Beheer en onderhoud van Windows Server-omgevingen. Beheer van Microsoft 365, Entra ID (Azure AD) en Exchange Online. Onderhoud en optimalisatie van virtualisatieplatformen (VMware en/of Hyper-V). Beheer van netwerkcomponenten zoals switches, firewalls, wifi en VPN-oplossingen. Opvolging van back-up- en disaster recovery-processen. Implementeren en bewaken van cybersecuritymaatregelen. Analyseren en oplossen van incidenten en technische problemen. Uitwerken en implementeren van infrastructuurprojecten. Opstellen en onderhouden van technische documentatie. Bieden van ICT-support aan interne gebruikers volgens afgesproken servicelevels. Samenwerken met externe leveranciers en partners. Vereisten Je beschikt over een hoger diploma in informatica of bent gelijkwaardig door ervaring. Je hebt minimaal 4 jaar relevante IT-ervaring. Je kunt je zowel mondeling als schriftelijk goed uitdrukken in het Nederlands of Frans (begrip van de andere landstaal is een pluspunt), én het Engels. Je hebt ervaring met beheer en ondersteuning van Windows Server 2022/2025, Active Directory, Entra ID, DNS en DHCP. Je bent ervaren in het bieden van end-user support (Windows 10, MS Office 365, hardware, printers). Je hebt kennis van en ervaring met M365 (SharePoint Online, Exchange Online, Teams, Intune, ...). Je beschikt over basis netwerkkennis (TCP/IP, basis switchbeheer, client-VPN, ...). M365/Security-certificering is een pluspunt. Je werkt nauwkeurig, planmatig en oplossingsgericht en weet prioriteiten te stellen. Je bent een echte teamspeler met een sterk analytisch vermogen en draagt ICT-security hoog in het vaandel. Je kan zelfstandig werken en neemt initiatief waar nodig. Je bent bereid je af en toe te verplaatsen naar andere ZORGI vestigingen.

review_candidates.title: Infrastructure Engineer
review_candidates.description: Infrastructure Engineer Position Summary The Infrastructure Engineer is a hands-on technical role supporting cloud services, Microsoft 365 environment, enterprise networking, SaaS platforms, and infrastructure systems. This role is responsible for the day-to-day administration, support, and improvement of the organization's hybrid technology environment, and contributes to modernization projects under the direction of senior engineering staff. The ideal candidate is comfortable across modern cloud and SaaS technologies while holding strong networking and systems fundamentals. They can take a defined task or issue and see it through to completion independently, know when to ask questions versus when to dig in, and are motivated to grow their technical depth over time. The ideal candidate can work directly with departments across the bank – partnering on projects, translating technical work into terms business stakeholders understand, and building the kind of working relationships that make cross-department initiatives succeed. We’re looking for someone who sees themselves not just as an individual contributor to IT, but as a collaborator the rest of the organization trusts and wants to work with. Clear communication, follow-through on commitments, and an ownership mindset are as core to this role as the technical work itself. Essential Responsibilities Cloud & Platform Services Administer and support cloud-based infrastructure and SaaS platforms. Assist with deployment, maintenance, and optimization of AWS, Azure, and Microsoft 365 services. Participate in cloud migration and modernization initiatives alongside senior staff. Monitor system health, performance, capacity, and availability, and follow up on what monitoring surfaces. Microsoft 365 & Identity Administer Microsoft 365 services including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Intune, and Entra ID. Support identity and access management in a hybrid environment, including Active Directory, conditional access, and endpoint compliance. Troubleshoot email, collaboration, authentication, and device management issues through to resolution. Enterprise Networking Support and maintain LAN, WAN, wireless, VPN, firewall, and internet connectivity across corporate, branch, and colocation environments. Perform structured network troubleshooting and escalate with clear documentation of what was tested and found. Participate in the implementation and maintenance of network infrastructure projects. SaaS Administration Administer business-critical SaaS applications: user provisioning, licensing, integrations, and access controls. Work directly with vendors to resolve technical issues rather than handing them off. Maintain inventory and documentation of cloud and SaaS platforms. Automation & Operations Experience scripting and automating day-to-day tasks highly preferred. Assist with infrastructure monitoring, alerting, reporting, and lifecycle management. Contribute to standardization and keeping technical documentation current. Security & Compliance Support implementation of security controls, vulnerability remediation, and access management. Participate in audit preparation, compliance activities, and incident response. Follow established security and risk management practices. Qualifications Required 3–6 years of experience supporting enterprise infrastructure environments. Experience administering Microsoft 365 and Entra ID. Solid networking fundamentals: switching, routing, firewalls, VPNs, and wireless, with real troubleshooting experience. Hands-on exposure to AWS or Azure — comfort navigating, deploying, and supporting cloud resources. Experience with identity management technologies. Scripting familiarity with PowerShell or another language. Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, with the discipline to document findings. Preferred AWS, Azure, Microsoft, Cisco, or Fortinet certifications. Experience with Intune and endpoint management in a hybrid-joined environment. Exposure to Infrastructure as Code tools. Experience in banking, financial services, or another regulated industry. Desired Attributes Follows work through to completion — owns a task or ticket from intake to resolution without it needing to be re-assigned or rescued. Works independently on defined tasks; asks good questions early rather than stalling or guessing. Communicates comfortably with non-technical staff and treats the rest of the business as customers. Balances operational support and ticket work with project contributions. Quick to learn unfamiliar platforms and genuinely curious about how things work. Receptive to direction and feedback, with the ambition to take on greater ownership over time.

Dat blijkt uit onze hoge scores in het medewerkerstevredenheidsonderzoek (MTO) en een sterke eNPS – medewerkers voelen zich gesteund, veilig en vrij om hun werk op een manier te doen dat bij hen past. Hier krijg jij energie van Als Security Operations Engineer bij Axians stap je binnen in een wereld waar techniek nooit stilstaat. Onze klanten, van ziekenhuizen tot overheidsinstellingen en grote enterprises, vertrouwen op complexe, moderne en bedrijfskritische netwerken. Jij bent degene die ervoor zorgt dat die infrastructuren veilig, stabiel en toekomstbestendig blijven. Je monitort niet alleen: je duikt diep de techniek in, lost uitdagende incidenten op, voert root cause analyses uit en werkt mee aan nieuwbouwprojecten die je later zelf in beheer neemt. Je krijgt veel autonomie om changes voor te bereiden en uit te voeren en je werkt met moderne tooling zoals FortiManager, Logic Monitoring, Ansible en Git. Samen met een team van ervaren engineers spar je over oplossingen, verbeteringen en optimalisaties, teamwork is voor ons enorm belangrijk! Je werkweek is afwisselend: een mix van incidentoplossing, changes, onderhoud, projectwerk en monitoring. Geen dag is hetzelfde, maar de rode draad is duidelijk: jij bent de technische spil die ervoor zorgt dat kritieke netwerken blijven draaien. Tegelijkertijd krijg je alle ruimte om te groeien. Ben jij klaar om jouw expertise in te zetten in een omgeving waar je écht het verschil maakt? Waar je werkt aan uitdagende netwerken, samen met een hecht team, en waar jouw ideeën en technische inzichten serieus worden genomen? Dan is dit jouw moment om impact te maken. Hier herken jij jezelf in Je bent een technisch sterke engineer die energie krijgt van complexe netwerk- en securityomgevingen. Als onderdeel van VINCI Energies combineren we de slagkracht van een internationale organisatie met de betrokkenheid van gespecialiseerde, lokale teams. Binnen ons Cyber Security team werken architecten, consultants, engineers en analisten nauw samen aan uitdagende securityvraagstukken. We geloven in kennisdeling, ondernemerschap en vertrouwen en geven je alle ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen, initiatief te nemen en samen met collega's het verschil te maken voor onze klanten. Binnen ons Cyber Security team werken engineers, consultants en architecten dagelijks aan het ontwerpen, implementeren en beheren van moderne security- en netwerkomgevingen. Zo combineren we de warmte van een hecht team met de mogelijkheden van een internationale organisatie. Samen zorgen we ervoor dat onze klanten kunnen vertrouwen op veilige en stabiele IT-infrastructuren.

review_candidates.title: Field Service Engineer, Senior
review_candidates.description: Job Title: Field Service Engineer, Senior Job Category: Information Technology Time Type: Full time Minimum Clearance Required to Start: Secret Employee Type: Regular-Long Term Assignment Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 10% Type of Travel: Continental US * * * The Opportunity CACI is seeking an experienced Field Service Engineer, Senior to support mission systems, information technology infrastructure, and operational engineering activities across the Indo-Pacific. The Field Service Engineer, Senior serves as CACI's senior systems engineering professional responsible for installing, integrating, configuring, sustaining, troubleshooting, repairing, and upgrading mission-critical hardware, software, communications, and network systems supporting logistics, mission support, facilities, training, and operational readiness. Reporting directly to the Platform Integration Lead, this position ensures deployed technologies remain fully operational and available to support Government missions across geographically dispersed and expeditionary environments. The Field Service Engineer works closely with Government stakeholders, systems engineers, network engineers, cybersecurity personnel, software developers, logistics planners, communications specialists, equipment manufacturers, and mission partners to deploy new technologies, resolve technical issues, perform preventive maintenance, and provide engineering support throughout the lifecycle of operational systems. This position contributes to successful program execution by maximizing system availability, improving technical performance, and enabling mission success throughout the Indo-Pacific theater. Responsibilities Install, configure, integrate, test, maintain, troubleshoot, repair, and upgrade mission-critical hardware, software, network, and communications systems. Perform field engineering support for logistics systems, command and control platforms, asset visibility technologies, edge computing devices, and enterprise information technology infrastructure. Conduct preventive maintenance, corrective maintenance, diagnostics, system health assessments, and lifecycle replacement activities. Coordinate installation and fielding of new hardware, software releases, firmware updates, and technology refresh initiatives. Troubleshoot complex hardware, operating system, network, database, and application issues while restoring operational capability. Coordinate with systems engineers, software developers, cybersecurity personnel, and network administrators to resolve technical problems and improve system performance. Support operational testing, technology demonstrations, field experiments, exercises, contingency operations, and mission rehearsals. Develop technical reports, engineering assessments, maintenance documentation, installation procedures, and executive-level status briefings. Maintain system configurations, engineering drawings, technical manuals, asset inventories, and maintenance records. Ensure systems comply with Department of Defense cybersecurity policies, technical standards, configuration management requirements, and contractual obligations. Provide technical training and mentoring to Government personnel and junior engineering staff. Coordinate with equipment manufacturers, vendors, subcontractors, and logistics personnel supporting field service activities. Support emergency service calls, rapid deployment requirements, and operational surge activities throughout the theater. Promote engineering excellence, system reliability, and continuous process improvement supporting mission readiness. Support geographically dispersed and expeditionary operations requiring responsive field engineering support. Required Qualifications: Minimum 8 years of experience supporting systems engineering, field service engineering, systems integration, information technology, network engineering, or technical support for Government or Department of Defense programs. Experience supporting Department of Defense, Joint, Combatant Command, Service Component, Special Operations organizations, or Defense Information Systems Agency (DISA) activities. Experience installing, configuring, maintaining, and troubleshooting enterprise hardware, software, communications equipment, servers, network infrastructure, or mission systems. Experience supporting field deployments, technology integration, preventive maintenance, or operational system sustainment. Experience preparing technical documentation, engineering reports, maintenance records, and executive-level briefings. Demonstrated ability to diagnose complex technical issues and restore mission-critical systems while supporting operational timelines. Desired Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Systems Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Network Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Experience supporting USSOCOM, SOCPAC, Geographic Combatant Commands, Joint Task Forces, Defense Information Systems Agency (DISA), or Special Operations organizations. Experience supporting Indo-Pacific operations, contested logistics, expeditionary communications, distributed mission command, edge computing, or operational technology environments. Experience utilizing VMware, Windows Server, Red Hat Enterprise Linux, Cisco networking equipment, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Power BI, Azure Government, AWS GovCloud, SCCM, SolarWinds, virtualization platforms, and enterprise systems management tools. Knowledge of enterprise systems integration, network architecture, hardware lifecycle management, virtualization, cloud technologies, Risk Management Framework (RMF), Zero Trust Architecture, and Department of Defense engineering standards. Professional certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CompTIA Network+, Microsoft Certified, Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP), VMware Certified Professional (VCP), Certified Systems Engineering Professional (CSEP), or equivalent systems engineering and information technology certifications are preferred. Experience supporting geographically dispersed Government programs involving OCONUS operations, Special Operations Forces, resilient information technology infrastructure, and mission-critical systems throughout the Indo-Pacific is highly desirable. This position is contingent on funding and may not be filled immediately. However, this position is representative of positions within CACI that are consistently available. Individuals who apply may also be considered for other positions at CACI. What You Can Expect A culture of integrity. At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation. An environment of trust. CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality. A focus on continuous growth. Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy. Pay Range There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits. Since this position can be worked in more than one location, the range shown is the national average for the position. The Proposed Salary Range For This Position Is $82,100-$172,400 CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.

review_candidates.title: Sr. Systems Administrator
review_candidates.description: Here at Scout Motors, we're carrying forward the heritage of one of the most iconic American vehicles in history. A vehicle dating back to 1960. One that forged the path for future generations of rugged SUVs and trucks and will do so once again. But Scout is more than just a brand, it’s a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work. The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn’t been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements — an all-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built-in gas-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range. At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go-getter with unrivaled passion. Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you're ready to drive change and make history, apply now! About The Role At Scout Motors, we’re carrying forward the heritage of one of the most iconic American vehicles in history—reimagining the rugged SUV and the all-electric pickup truck for a new generation. Building these vehicles takes a world-class IT organization, and our Infrastructure & Support team is the backbone that keeps Scout’s people, systems, and production environments running. As a Senior Systems Administrator, you’ll be a senior technical owner of our enterprise infrastructure across compute, storage, identity, and cloud. You’ll lead complex incident and problem resolution, champion automation, and ensure the availability, performance, and security of the systems Scout depends on every day. What you’ll do Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick-up truck & rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following: Design, implement, and maintain enterprise infrastructure across compute, storage, identity, and cloud platforms. Act as a senior subject matter expert for core infrastructure services, supporting availability, performance, monitoring, and operational readiness of production systems. Lead Tier-3 incident resolution and root-cause analysis, recommending and executing sustainable corrective actions. Champion a culture of automation and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to reduce manual errors, accelerate deployments, and strengthen infrastructure security. Administer Azure, Power Platform, Microsoft Intune, Microsoft 365, and other Microsoft cloud services, including the setup, maintenance, and monitoring of Azure-based resources, databases, and applications. Partner with the Security team to ensure smooth, secure inter-departmental operations. Support and execute network-related tasks as needed to maintain reliable IT operations. Author and maintain standard operating procedures and other critical IT documentation. Mentor systems administrators and serve as a senior escalation point for the broader infrastructure and service desk teams. Location & Travel Expectations : This role may be based out of the Scout Motors corporate headquarters in Charlotte, NC. This role requires 4-5 days per week in the office, with regular in-person meetings and events. Applicants should expect that the role will require the ability to convene with Scout colleagues in person and travel to participate in events on behalf of the company from time to time.. What you’ll bring We expect all Scout employees to have integrity, curiosity, resourcefulness, and strive to exhibit a positive attitude, as well as a growth mindset. You’ll be comfortable with change and flexible in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. You’ll take a collaborative approach to achieve ambitious goals. Here's what else you'll bring: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or an equivalent field is a plus. 8+ years of experience in storage solutions, virtualization, system design, deployment, and administration. Proven ownership of complex infrastructure environments across compute, storage, networking, and virtualization. Strong experience with cloud platforms—particularly Azure. Deep understanding of Windows and/or Linux server administration. Solid knowledge of identity and access management and enterprise authentication systems. Strong communication and documentation skills, with the ability to mentor and guide other team members. Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams. What you'll gain The benefits of joining Scout include the chance to build products and a company from the ground up. This is a chance to create something new and lasting – with an iconic brand at its foundation. In addition, Scout provides competitive compensation and benefits to support your physical, mental, and financial wellbeing. Program specifics are detailed in company policies and employee benefit guides, select highlights: Competitive insurance including: Medical, dental, vision and income protection plans 401(k) program with: An employer match and immediate vesting Generous Paid Time Off including: 20 days planned PTO, as accrued 40 hours of unplanned PTO and 14 company or floating holidays, annually Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave for biological and adoptive parents of all genders Paid leave for circumstances related to bereavement, jury duty, voting time, or military leave Pay Transparency This is a full-time, exempt position eligible to receive a base salary and to participate in an annual performance bonus program. Final salary offered will be determined based on factors including but not limited to the candidate's skills and experience. The annual performance bonus program is preset and not candidate dependent. Initial base salary range = $120,000.00 - $145,000.00 Internal leveling code: IC8 Notice to applicants: To be considered for career opportunities at Scout Motors, applicants must be 18 years of age or older. Residing in San Francisco: Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Scout Motors will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Residing in Los Angeles: Scout Motors will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance. Residing in New York City: This role is not eligible for remote work in New York City. Equal Opportunity Scout Motors is committed to employing a diverse workforce and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, disability, pregnancy, or any other characteristics protected by law. Scout Motors is committed to compliance with all applicable fair employment practice laws. If you require reasonable accommodation to complete a job application, pre-employment testing, or a job interview or to otherwise participate in the hiring process, please contact ScoutAccommodations@scoutmotors.com.

review_candidates.description: Department: Corporate/Administrative Location: Remote- USA Compensation: $110,000 - $120,000 / year Description We are seeking an AWS Infrastructure Engineer with deep expertise in Microsoft SQL Server (RDS & EC2), AWS cloud architecture, and enterprise ERP infrastructure. Direct experience supporting Deltek Vantagepoint (or Deltek Vision) within an AWS-hosted environment is required. Preference will be given to candidates with experience supporting AEC (Architecture, Engineering, and Construction) organizations utilizing Deltek as their core ERP platform. Key Responsibilities: Database Infrastructure: Architect and manage production Microsoft SQL Server deployments on AWS RDS and native EC2 instances. Deltek Environment Support: Maintain and optimize AWS infrastructure supporting Deltek Vantagepoint, Deltek Vision, and related reporting platforms (SSRS). ERP Middleware Support: Maintain AWS platform integrations supporting Deltek Vantagepoint, third-party HRIS systems, SQL automations, and enterprise workflows. High Availability & Disaster Recovery: Design and implement database backup, point-in-time recovery, high availability, and multi-region disaster recovery solutions. Performance Tuning: Troubleshoot infrastructure bottlenecks, optimize storage and database performance, and right-size AWS resources to improve efficiency and control costs. Security & Compliance: Enforce enterprise security standards across AWS, including IAM, network segmentation, encryption, access controls, and monitoring. Documentation: Maintain accurate technical documentation for AWS architecture, database environments, integrations, security controls, and standard operating procedures. Required Skills, Knowledge and Expertise: AWS & Cloud Infrastructure: 5+ years of experience managing AWS services, including: EC2 RDS VPC Route53 IAM CloudWatch SNS 1+ years of experience developing or supporting serverless AWS services, including Lambda and Step Functions. Deltek ERP Experience (Required): 2+ years of direct experience supporting Deltek Vantagepoint or advanced Deltek Vision environments. Experience administering AWS infrastructure supporting Deltek ERP applications and databases. Working knowledge of Deltek Vantagepoint architecture, application dependencies, integrations, reporting infrastructure, and database schemas. Experience supporting Deltek environments within AEC industry organizations strongly preferred. Microsoft SQL Server: Advanced SQL Server administration experience within AWS environments. Experience managing SQL Server on both RDS and EC2. Strong knowledge of Always On Availability Groups, backup/recovery, performance tuning, and high-availability design. Reporting and Integrations: Direct experience architecting or supporting SSRS environments. Experience supporting ERP-related integrations, middleware, APIs, and automated data workflows. Operating Systems: Strong Windows Server administration experience in AWS-hosted enterprise environments. Preferred Qualifications: AWS Certified SysOps Administrator Associate, AWS Certified CloudOps Engineer Associate, or AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional. Experience developing data transformation and automation solutions using Python. PCED Certified Entry-Level Data Analyst with Python (or higher certification). Experience supporting Deltek implementations, upgrades, migrations, or cloud transformation. Remote Work Requirement: Dedicated and secure home office workspace. Reliable high-speed internet connection. Ability to collaborate effectively across multiple U.S. time zones. Ideal candidate: The ideal candidate has hands-on experience supporting Deltek Vantagepoint or Deltek Vision in an AWS environment, understands the technology ecosystem commonly found within AEC firms, and can independently manage the infrastructure, database, reporting, and integration components critical to a high-performing Deltek ERP platform. Trilon is backed by Alpine Investors, a PeopleFirst Private Equity Firm. Trilon currently comprises 5,500+ staff across the US. For more information, visit www.trilon.com. Pay Transparency The base salary range for this role is indicated in the posting. This range reflects the company’s good faith estimate of the compensation for this position at the time of posting. Final compensation will be determined based on factors such as experience, skills, qualifications, internal equity, and geographic location.

review_candidates.title: Senior Windows Server Administrator
review_candidates.description: A global technology business is looking for a Senior Windows Server Administrator to become the go-to escalation point for complex Wintel infrastructure issues. This is a role for someone who enjoys deep technical troubleshooting, not just keeping the lights on. You will be joining a business with a sizeable, established technology environment and current projects including a move from VMware towards Azure Local, alongside wider infrastructure integration work across newly acquired sites. The role is based in Southampton and is office based. Senior Windows Server Administrator Salary: £50,000 - £60,000 + benefits Location: Southampton, office based 12 Month Fixed Term Contract You will take ownership of complex Windows Server and infrastructure challenges, supporting a broad environment covering server, virtualisation, storage, file, email and collaboration technologies. The business needs someone who can be trusted as a senior technical escalation point, particularly when incidents are high priority, time-sensitive, or visible to senior stakeholders. This is not a role for someone who only wants to follow runbooks. You will be expected to understand how systems fit together, diagnose issues under pressure, explain your thinking clearly, and help less experienced administrators develop their own technical capability. In the role, you will: Lead troubleshooting across Windows Server environments Act as a senior escalation point for complex infrastructure issues Support projects involving virtualisation and hyper-converged infrastructure Contribute to the move from VMware towards Azure Local Work across technologies including server, storage, file, email and collaboration systems Help define technical priorities, improvements and roadmap activity Mentor other IT Administrators within the team Support security, resilience, capacity and regulatory requirements Research new technologies and recommend practical, cost-effective solutions The most important requirements are strong Windows Server experience and excellent troubleshooting ability. You should be confident investigating issues properly, using tools such as event logs, understanding areas such as Active Directory, Group Policy, replication, certificates and wider infrastructure dependencies. You do not need to have worked with every technology listed below, but experience across any of the following would be useful: VMware, Hyper-V or Azure Local Citrix SCCM / MECM Exchange Thycotic Zabbix or other enterprise monitoring tools Agile working environments You will need to be able to travel within Europe without restriction when required. Benefits include: Up to 26 days holiday, plus bank holidays Additional birthday and work anniversary celebration days after probation 5% employer pension contribution Employee share purchase scheme with discounted shares Private medical, healthcare cash plan and Digital GP access Life assurance, income protection and critical illness cover The interview process is two stages: an initial 30-45 minute Teams call, followed by an onsite interview in Southampton. For more information, please apply or contact Chris Lynes at Spectrum IT Recruitment for a confidential conversation. Spectrum IT Recruitment (South) Limited is acting as an Employment Agency in relation to this vacancy. LNKD1_UKTJ

review_candidates.title: Sr. Systems Engineer (Linux)
review_candidates.description: Job Description About Williams-Sonoma, Inc. Founded in 1956 and headquartered in San Francisco, California, Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is a Fortune 500, digital first, multi-channel specialty retailer. Our company vision is to own the home, and the places where our customers work, stay, and play. We bring the latest home furnishing trends to life for customers through the individual lenses of our ten distinct brands, each serving different life stages and rooms of the home and beyond. Our brands include Williams Sonoma, Williams Sonoma Home, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn Teen, West Elm, Rejuvenation, Mark & Graham, GreenRow, and Dormify. We are committed to sustainability, continuously working to protect our planet, while building an open and collaborative culture across our organization. With more than 500 retail stores globally and multiple international franchise operations, technology is a core driver of our business strategy. We build and operate in-house platforms powering e-commerce, supply chain, merchandising, analytics, and customer experience ecosystems worldwide. Engineers at the Williams-Sonoma India Technology Center build and scale digital commerce platforms that power these global brands, serving millions of customers worldwide. Role Overview As Senior Linux Platform Engineer, you will be responsible for the design, automation, standardization, and lifecycle management of Williams-Sonoma's Linux estate. You will help improve platform reliability, security, scalability, and operational efficiency across on-premises and cloud-hosted environments. This role is ideal for a hands-on infrastructure engineer with strong Linux fundamentals, growing automation capabilities, and sound operational judgment. You will partner closely with senior engineers, architects, and support teams to deliver reliable platform services, improve day-to-day operations, and contribute to the continued evolution of Linux platform engineering. Impact of the Role Improve platform reliability, security, scalability, and operational efficiency across enterprise Linux environments. Drive automation and infrastructure-as-code practices across provisioning, configuration, patching, compliance, and operational workflows. Support the modernization and evolution of Linux platform engineering. Enhance operational readiness, incident response effectiveness, and platform observability. Support enterprise infrastructure powering large-scale digital commerce and business operations. Technology Platforms You Will Work On Red Hat Enterprise Linux Red Hat Satellite Ansible GitHub Kubernetes Docker Jenkins Bash and Python scripting Virtualization and cloud infrastructure platforms Apache and Tomcat Linux-hosted database platforms Active Directory integration for Linux Monitoring and observability platforms Key Responsibilities Define, implement, and maintain enterprise standards for Linux platforms, including Red Hat Enterprise Linux and related tooling. Engineer and support platform capabilities across OS lifecycle management, patching, repository services, configuration management, automation, and platform hardening. Design and optimize Linux platform performance through kernel, system, and application tuning based on capacity, reliability, and availability requirements. Drive automation and infrastructure-as-code practices across provisioning, configuration, patching, compliance, and operational workflows. Leverage AI-assisted engineering practices for personal productivity and continuous improvement, including proactive monitoring workflows, script development, and log analysis to accelerate troubleshooting, reduce manual effort, and improve operational insight. Administer and improve core Linux support services and toolchains such as Satellite, Ansible, GitHub, Kubernetes, Docker, Jenkins, and related platform components. Partner with architects and peer engineering teams to evaluate new technologies, run proof-of-concept initiatives, and contribute to the Linux platform roadmap. Gather technical and business requirements and translate them into scalable infrastructure designs and implementation plans. Collaborate closely with production support and Level 2 operations teams to improve runbooks, handoffs, operational readiness, and incident response effectiveness. Create and maintain high-quality engineering documentation, including standards, build guides, implementation records, and operational procedures. Provide data-driven recommendations on platform health, capacity, risk, and modernization opportunities. Share knowledge with other engineers through documentation, collaboration, design reviews, and hands-on problem solving. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Sciences, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent combination of related education, training, and experience. 10+ years of managing Linux operating systems in an enterprise environment. 7+ years leading technical teams that solve complex problems and provide detailed technical and business analysis. Deep expertise in Linux systems engineering within complex enterprise environments, including performance, security, lifecycle management, and troubleshooting. Strong experience with Red Hat Enterprise Linux and adjacent platform tooling for package management, patching, configuration, and automation. Hands-on experience with scripting and automation using Bash, Python, and other shell-based tooling. Demonstrated interest in responsibly using AI tools to strengthen personal engineering effectiveness, especially for drafting scripts, identifying patterns in logs and telemetry, and supporting faster root-cause analysis. Working knowledge of virtualization and cloud infrastructure platforms, along with modern container technologies and orchestration concepts. Experience with configuration management and automation platforms such as Ansible or equivalent tools. Strong understanding of Linux security best practices, system hardening, access controls, and operational compliance requirements. Experience supporting web and middleware stacks on Linux, such as Apache and Tomcat, and familiarity with database platforms in Linux-hosted environments. Experience with enterprise patching and content management solutions such as Red Hat Satellite is strongly preferred. Familiarity with Active Directory integration for Linux, including service principals, Kerberos, and keytab-based authentication, is a plus. Strong documentation, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions clearly to engineering and business stakeholders. A practical, ownership-oriented mindset and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. Fundamental understanding of deploying and supporting Linux servers in a highly available and fault tolerant enterprise level environment. Delivery of fully integrated, automated, and highly available Linux provisioning process with enterprise level tools and technologies. Superior oral and written communication skills. Superior computer skills including MS Windows and MS Office including Excel, Access, Visio, and Word. ServiceNow experience is a plus. Knowledge of theory and principles of project management. Why Join Williams-Sonoma India Technology Center Our people first and performance driven culture means that we provide opportunities to grow and build a career and invest in the well-being of our associates, including comprehensive benefits to support you and your family. Scale and innovation of a Fortune 500 company combined with a high-ownership that empowers engineers to make real impact. Build and operate large-scale digital commerce platforms serving millions of customers worldwide, working on systems that run at global scale. Continuous learning environment with opportunities to work on cutting-edge technologies, AI-driven solutions, and large-scale engineering challenges. Hybrid work model designed for flexibility and collaboration, with two in-office days for team engagement. About Us Williams-Sonoma India Pvt. Ltd. Founded in 1956, Williams-Sonoma Inc. is the premier specialty retailer of high-quality products for the kitchen and home in the United States. Today, Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is one of the United States' largest e-commerce retailers with some of the best known and most beloved brands in home furnishings. Our family of brands are Williams-Sonoma, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn Teens, West Elm, Williams-Sonoma Home, Rejuvenation, and Mark and Graham. We currently operate retail stores globally. Our products are also available to customers through our catalogs and online worldwide. Williams-Sonoma India sourcing office was established in 2013. We are based in Gurugram, India. We are sourcing premium products across all categories of Home Furnishing and recorded double digit year-on-year growth. We have a dynamic team of over 100 members handling versatile vendors across India, Nepal & Bangladesh. We are looking to onboard talented people and create successful professional journey.

TU Delft Werken bij TU Delft betekent bijdragen aan oplossingen die er echt toe doen. De complexiteit en grootte van de organisatie zorgen ervoor dat ons werk vaak een uitdagende puzzel is. De grootste opdracht waar we de komende jaren als TU Delft voor staan, is het versnellen van de digitalisering om zo onze positie als universiteit van wereldklasse te versterken We werken veel samen met de specialisten op onze eigen ICT-afdeling en met onze collega’s verspreid over de universiteit. De campus is een bruisende omgeving waar altijd van alles gebeurt. De cultuur is informeel en inclusief. Bovendien krijg je binnen de directie ICT het vertrouwen en de vrijheid om je eigen werk in te delen. Er is veel mogelijk op het gebied van opleidingen en wij vinden jouw persoonlijke ontwikkeling belangrijk. Tijdelijk met uitzicht op vast. Een functieomvang van 36-40 uur per week. Een salaris dat is gebaseerd op Schaal 11 uit de CAO Nederlandse Universiteiten met salaris tussen €4925- €6682 bruto per maand op basis van een volledige werkweek (38 uur), plus 8% vakantiegeld en een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,3%. Een uitstekende pensioenregeling via het ABP. De mogelijkheid om jaarlijks een individueel arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket samen te stellen. Korting bij zorgverzekeraars op aanvullende pakketten. Flexibele werkweek. Jaarlijks 232 verlofuren (bij 38 uur). Via het individueel keuzebudget kun je bovendien verlofuren verkopen of bijkopen. Volop mogelijkheden om opleidingen, trainingen en cursussen te volgen. Gedeeltelijk doorbetaald ouderschapsverlof. Aandacht voor gezond en energiek werken met het vitaliteitsprogramma. Additionele informatie Voor meer informatie over deze vacature, neem contact op met Erwin Karselius, via E.C.Karselius@tudelft.nl. Sollicitatieprocedure Heb je interesse in deze vacature? Solliciteer dan uiterlijk 12 september 2026 via de sollicitatiebutton en upload de volgende documenten: CV Motivatiebrief Je kunt je sollicitatie richten aan Michelle Ton. TU Delft voert in het kader van kennisveiligheid een risicobeoordeling uit bij het werven van personeel. Dit doen wij onder meer om ongewenste overdracht van gevoelige kennis en technologie te voorkomen. De beoordeling gebeurt op basis van informatie die door kandidaat zelf is aangeleverd, zoals de motivatiebrief en het cv. De beoordeling vindt plaats bij de laatst overgebleven kandidaten in het selectieproces. Wanneer de uitkomst van de risicobeoordeling negatief is, dan wordt de kandidaat daarover geïnformeerd. De verwerking van persoonsgegevens in het kader van deze risicobeoordeling vindt plaats op basis van de wettelijke grondslag van de AVG ‘uitvoering van de publieke taak van algemeen belang’. Meer informatie over deze beoordeling vind je op onze website over kennisveiligheid. Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

review_candidates.title: Software Engineer – DevOps Platform
review_candidates.description: We’re looking for a Software Engineer to join our Devops Platform team, where you will blend linux system administration and software engineering skills to build and maintain all our infrastructure and core services running in our data centers and the cloud. Wealthfront’s Infrastructure team is a team of “Generalists with Expertise” who adhere to DevOps principles by building software and services to automate all infrastructure operations. Our objective is to empower all our developers to build and own their systems end-to-end. We're a modern infrastructure engineering team, believing strongly in testing, automation, and standardization through software. We operate in both physical data centers and AWS environments, and leverage open source technologies such as containers, MariaDB, NGINX, Jenkins, and Chef, as well as build tools and services using Go and Java to deliver automated infrastructure to our engineers and ultimately serve our clients. About Wealthfront Engineering Wealthfront’s culture centers around continuous learning, innovation, and quality-driven software development. With high quality software as our ultimate engineering objective, our key tactic is automation: • Wealthfront software automates the financial services we provide to our clients, and within these services we automate the collection of data that we learn from on our way to making our services even better. • Wealthfront engineers function as builder/operators, with dual responsibility for building the system and operating it in production. Any toil that this brings about is automated away by engineers. This investment in automation is expected, and the prioritization of it is always built into our planning and execution. • Wealthfront engineers automate our development processes. For example, Wealthfront engineers automate all of our testing. Manual testing is not part of the software development lifecycle at Wealthfront. • Wealthfront engineers automate observability in case of failure. If something is up, our systems inform engineers appropriately. If our systems are quiet, they are healthy. If you are drawn to being an engineer within such an environment, and having outsized impact as an engineer at a magnitude that is only available within a company achieving greatness at our size (~350 employees, half in engineering), then we want to hear from you! As a member of the team, you will: Maintain our core infrastructure by writing software to automate application deployment, configure our infrastructure, and manage critical services such as our databases. Ensure that mission critical services operate reliably by triaging and fixing operational issues in linux environments as an on-call engineer, participating in post-mortems, and implementing improvements to prevent future issues. Design, implement, and deploy internal tools and services to accelerate productivity of the wider Engineering team and enable direct ownership of operations. Help manage our server hardware in our physical data centers which may occasionally include travel to our Bay Area or New Jersey data centers for onsite projects. Be involved in key decisions regarding the evolution of our infrastructure This role could be a fit if you have: A BS or MS in Computer Science or an Engineering field Experience with running and troubleshooting modern Linux systems and services in production 2+ years of experience developing reliable production-grade software in Java, Go, or other similar languages Proficiency with at least one automation technology such as Terraform, Chef, or Puppet Successfully designed and deployed mission-critical complex distributed systems Excellent critical thinking and communications skills with a desire to both learn from and educate your peers Once you join, Wealthfront will: Pair you with a 1:1 mentor to guide you through our onboarding program. Encourage you to lead impactful projects which match your professional goals. Support your professional development by providing feedback during weekly 1:1s and during our bi-annual reviews. Be given the opportunity to participate in designing systems and planning for the future of our infrastructure Estimated annual salary range: $150,000 - $189,000 plus equity and a discretionary bonus. Benefits include medical, vision, dental, 401K plan, generous time off, parental leave, wellness reimbursements, professional development, employee investing discount, and more! About Wealthfront Here at Wealthfront, our mission is to create a financial system that favors people, not institutions. We do this by leveraging technology to build powerful, low-cost, and easy-to-use financial products that help modern investors grow and manage their money. new_matches.description: Job Title: Field Service Engineer, Senior Job Category: Information Technology Time Type: Full time Minimum Clearance Required to Start: Secret Employee Type: Regular-Long Term Assignment Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 10% Type of Travel: Continental US * * * The Opportunity CACI is seeking an experienced Field Service Engineer, Senior to support mission systems, information technology infrastructure, and operational engineering activities across the Indo-Pacific. The Field Service Engineer, Senior serves as CACI's senior systems engineering professional responsible for installing, integrating, configuring, sustaining, troubleshooting, repairing, and upgrading mission-critical hardware, software, communications, and network systems supporting logistics, mission support, facilities, training, and operational readiness. Reporting directly to the Platform Integration Lead, this position ensures deployed technologies remain fully operational and available to support Government missions across geographically dispersed and expeditionary environments. The Field Service Engineer works closely with Government stakeholders, systems engineers, network engineers, cybersecurity personnel, software developers, logistics planners, communications specialists, equipment manufacturers, and mission partners to deploy new technologies, resolve technical issues, perform preventive maintenance, and provide engineering support throughout the lifecycle of operational systems. This position contributes to successful program execution by maximizing system availability, improving technical performance, and enabling mission success throughout the Indo-Pacific theater. Responsibilities Install, configure, integrate, test, maintain, troubleshoot, repair, and upgrade mission-critical hardware, software, network, and communications systems. Perform field engineering support for logistics systems, command and control platforms, asset visibility technologies, edge computing devices, and enterprise information technology infrastructure. Conduct preventive maintenance, corrective maintenance, diagnostics, system health assessments, and lifecycle replacement activities. Coordinate installation and fielding of new hardware, software releases, firmware updates, and technology refresh initiatives. Troubleshoot complex hardware, operating system, network, database, and application issues while restoring operational capability. Coordinate with systems engineers, software developers, cybersecurity personnel, and network administrators to resolve technical problems and improve system performance. Support operational testing, technology demonstrations, field experiments, exercises, contingency operations, and mission rehearsals. Develop technical reports, engineering assessments, maintenance documentation, installation procedures, and executive-level status briefings. Maintain system configurations, engineering drawings, technical manuals, asset inventories, and maintenance records. Ensure systems comply with Department of Defense cybersecurity policies, technical standards, configuration management requirements, and contractual obligations. Provide technical training and mentoring to Government personnel and junior engineering staff. Coordinate with equipment manufacturers, vendors, subcontractors, and logistics personnel supporting field service activities. Support emergency service calls, rapid deployment requirements, and operational surge activities throughout the theater. Promote engineering excellence, system reliability, and continuous process improvement supporting mission readiness. Support geographically dispersed and expeditionary operations requiring responsive field engineering support. Required Qualifications: Minimum 8 years of experience supporting systems engineering, field service engineering, systems integration, information technology, network engineering, or technical support for Government or Department of Defense programs. Experience supporting Department of Defense, Joint, Combatant Command, Service Component, Special Operations organizations, or Defense Information Systems Agency (DISA) activities. Experience installing, configuring, maintaining, and troubleshooting enterprise hardware, software, communications equipment, servers, network infrastructure, or mission systems. Experience supporting field deployments, technology integration, preventive maintenance, or operational system sustainment. Experience preparing technical documentation, engineering reports, maintenance records, and executive-level briefings. Demonstrated ability to diagnose complex technical issues and restore mission-critical systems while supporting operational timelines. Desired Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Systems Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Network Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Experience supporting USSOCOM, SOCPAC, Geographic Combatant Commands, Joint Task Forces, Defense Information Systems Agency (DISA), or Special Operations organizations. Experience supporting Indo-Pacific operations, contested logistics, expeditionary communications, distributed mission command, edge computing, or operational technology environments. Experience utilizing VMware, Windows Server, Red Hat Enterprise Linux, Cisco networking equipment, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Power BI, Azure Government, AWS GovCloud, SCCM, SolarWinds, virtualization platforms, and enterprise systems management tools. Knowledge of enterprise systems integration, network architecture, hardware lifecycle management, virtualization, cloud technologies, Risk Management Framework (RMF), Zero Trust Architecture, and Department of Defense engineering standards. Professional certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CompTIA Network+, Microsoft Certified, Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP), VMware Certified Professional (VCP), Certified Systems Engineering Professional (CSEP), or equivalent systems engineering and information technology certifications are preferred. Experience supporting geographically dispersed Government programs involving OCONUS operations, Special Operations Forces, resilient information technology infrastructure, and mission-critical systems throughout the Indo-Pacific is highly desirable. This position is contingent on funding and may not be filled immediately. However, this position is representative of positions within CACI that are consistently available. Individuals who apply may also be considered for other positions at CACI. What You Can Expect A culture of integrity. At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation. An environment of trust. CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality. A focus on continuous growth. Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy. Pay Range There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits. Since this position can be worked in more than one location, the range shown is the national average for the position. The Proposed Salary Range For This Position Is $82,100-$172,400 CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.

new_matches.description: Here at Scout Motors, we're carrying forward the heritage of one of the most iconic American vehicles in history. A vehicle dating back to 1960. One that forged the path for future generations of rugged SUVs and trucks and will do so once again. But Scout is more than just a brand, it’s a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work. The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn’t been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements — an all-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built-in gas-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range. At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go-getter with unrivaled passion. Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you're ready to drive change and make history, apply now! About The Role At Scout Motors, we’re carrying forward the heritage of one of the most iconic American vehicles in history—reimagining the rugged SUV and the all-electric pickup truck for a new generation. Building these vehicles takes a world-class IT organization, and our Infrastructure & Support team is the backbone that keeps Scout’s people, systems, and production environments running. As a Senior Systems Administrator, you’ll be a senior technical owner of our enterprise infrastructure across compute, storage, identity, and cloud. You’ll lead complex incident and problem resolution, champion automation, and ensure the availability, performance, and security of the systems Scout depends on every day. What you’ll do Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick-up truck & rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following: Design, implement, and maintain enterprise infrastructure across compute, storage, identity, and cloud platforms. Act as a senior subject matter expert for core infrastructure services, supporting availability, performance, monitoring, and operational readiness of production systems. Lead Tier-3 incident resolution and root-cause analysis, recommending and executing sustainable corrective actions. Champion a culture of automation and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to reduce manual errors, accelerate deployments, and strengthen infrastructure security. Administer Azure, Power Platform, Microsoft Intune, Microsoft 365, and other Microsoft cloud services, including the setup, maintenance, and monitoring of Azure-based resources, databases, and applications. Partner with the Security team to ensure smooth, secure inter-departmental operations. Support and execute network-related tasks as needed to maintain reliable IT operations. Author and maintain standard operating procedures and other critical IT documentation. Mentor systems administrators and serve as a senior escalation point for the broader infrastructure and service desk teams. Location & Travel Expectations : This role may be based out of the Scout Motors corporate headquarters in Charlotte, NC. This role requires 4-5 days per week in the office, with regular in-person meetings and events. Applicants should expect that the role will require the ability to convene with Scout colleagues in person and travel to participate in events on behalf of the company from time to time.. What you’ll bring We expect all Scout employees to have integrity, curiosity, resourcefulness, and strive to exhibit a positive attitude, as well as a growth mindset. You’ll be comfortable with change and flexible in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. You’ll take a collaborative approach to achieve ambitious goals. Here's what else you'll bring: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or an equivalent field is a plus. 8+ years of experience in storage solutions, virtualization, system design, deployment, and administration. Proven ownership of complex infrastructure environments across compute, storage, networking, and virtualization. Strong experience with cloud platforms—particularly Azure. Deep understanding of Windows and/or Linux server administration. Solid knowledge of identity and access management and enterprise authentication systems. Strong communication and documentation skills, with the ability to mentor and guide other team members. Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams. What you'll gain The benefits of joining Scout include the chance to build products and a company from the ground up. This is a chance to create something new and lasting – with an iconic brand at its foundation. In addition, Scout provides competitive compensation and benefits to support your physical, mental, and financial wellbeing. Program specifics are detailed in company policies and employee benefit guides, select highlights: Competitive insurance including: Medical, dental, vision and income protection plans 401(k) program with: An employer match and immediate vesting Generous Paid Time Off including: 20 days planned PTO, as accrued 40 hours of unplanned PTO and 14 company or floating holidays, annually Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave for biological and adoptive parents of all genders Paid leave for circumstances related to bereavement, jury duty, voting time, or military leave Pay Transparency This is a full-time, exempt position eligible to receive a base salary and to participate in an annual performance bonus program. Final salary offered will be determined based on factors including but not limited to the candidate's skills and experience. The annual performance bonus program is preset and not candidate dependent. Initial base salary range = $120,000.00 - $145,000.00 Internal leveling code: IC8 Notice to applicants: To be considered for career opportunities at Scout Motors, applicants must be 18 years of age or older. Residing in San Francisco: Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Scout Motors will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Residing in Los Angeles: Scout Motors will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance. Residing in New York City: This role is not eligible for remote work in New York City. Equal Opportunity Scout Motors is committed to employing a diverse workforce and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, disability, pregnancy, or any other characteristics protected by law. Scout Motors is committed to compliance with all applicable fair employment practice laws. If you require reasonable accommodation to complete a job application, pre-employment testing, or a job interview or to otherwise participate in the hiring process, please contact ScoutAccommodations@scoutmotors.com.

The business also builds capabilities that can be used for a wide range of applications in both traditional and non-traditional environments; providing leadership in the advancement of technological modernisation of complex enterprises within Government. The Opportunity Join Leidos Australia’s AGO GEO SPACES program and contribute to the delivery of advanced national security capabilities in a highly secure, mission-critical environment. As a Linux Administrator, you will play a key role in maintaining and enhancing the Linux infrastructure that supports essential operational outcomes, working alongside experienced engineers and technology specialists. Administer and maintain virtualised and physical infrastructure, including VMware, KVM, HP OneView and GreenLake platforms, while supporting ongoing system optimisation and lifecycle activities. Develop, automate and standardise system configurations using tools such as Ansible, Puppet and Chef, with a focus on operational efficiency, consistency and compliance. Support security and access management requirements through the administration of authentication services, implementation of security controls and automation of routine administration tasks using scripting technologies. About You You are a Linux systems professional who enjoys solving complex technical challenges and working within a secure, high-assurance environment. You bring experience across enterprise infrastructure technologies and are committed to maintaining stable, secure and well-managed platforms that enable critical business and operational outcomes. Essential Experience administering enterprise Linux environments, including distributions such as RHEL, CentOS, Ubuntu and SUSE. Capability in managing user access, authentication and directory services, including LDAP-based solutions such as OpenLDAP. Experience with configuration management and automation tools including Ansible, Puppet or Chef. Knowledge of virtualisation technologies, including VMware ESXi/vSphere, KVM or similar platforms. Experience providing Level 2 and/or Level 3 support, with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex infrastructure issues. Experience implementing and maintaining security controls, system hardening practices and operational compliance requirements. Capability in scripting and automation using Bash, Python, Perl or similar technologies. Advantageous Experience supporting large-scale, mission-critical or highly regulated environments. Familiarity with Kickstart or similar operating system deployment and Standard Operating Environment (SOE) management practices. Exposure to HP OneView, GreenLake or comparable enterprise infrastructure management platforms. new_matches.description: Jij zorgt ervoor dat meer dan 40.000 studenten en medewerkers veilig toegang hebben tot alle Microsoft 365-diensten van TU Delft. Je werkt mee aan een uitdagende Microsoft 365-omgeving en speelt een sleutelrol in de verdere ontwikkeling van identity, cloud security en messaging. Daarbij krijg je veel ruimte om technische keuzes te maken, automatisering verder te brengen en de Microsoft-platformstrategie mede vorm te geven. Functieomschrijving Binnen TU Delft vertrouwen bijna 40.000 gebruikers dagelijks op Microsoft 365 voor communicatie, samenwerking en toegang tot digitale voorzieningen. De continuïteit, veiligheid en betrouwbaarheid van deze omgeving zijn essentieel voor onderwijs, onderzoek en bedrijfsvoering. Als Senior Microsoft 365 Engineer speel jij hierin een sleutelrol. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerpen, beheren, automatiseren en verder ontwikkelen van onze Microsoft 365-omgeving, met een sterke focus op Entra ID, Active Directory en hybrid identity. Je werkt aan moderne identity-oplossingen rondom Entra ID, RBAC, lifecycle management en hybrid identity. Je denkt actief mee over de technische roadmap van het Microsoft-platform en adviseert architecten en productowners over toekomstige ontwikkelingen. Daarbij draag je actief bij aan de overgang van traditionele on-premises oplossingen naar moderne cloudplatformen. Je werkt aan stabiele, veilige en toekomstbestendige oplossingen die schaalbaar en goed beheerbaar zijn. Je wordt onderdeel van het Identity Access Management en Directory Services team. Je werkt dagelijks samen met specialisten op het gebied van cloud, security, networking en enterprise architectuur om het Microsoft-platform continu verder te ontwikkelen. Je borgt kennis binnen het team, coacht collega's en draagt actief bij aan de verdere professionalisering van het Microsoft-platform. Werken bij TU Delft betekent streven naar een langdurige samenwerking en voortdurende verbetering in een innovatieve omgeving, met ruimte voor eigen initiatief. Je krijgt veel ruimte om nieuwe Microsoft-technologieën te verkennen, certificeringen te behalen en de technische koers van het platform mede te bepalen. Functie-eisen Je hebt hbo-werk- en denkniveau en ruime ervaring met Microsoft 365 in een complexe enterprise-omgeving, bij voorkeur in de onderwijssector. Je beschikt over grondige kennis van en ervaring met Entra ID, Active Directory, hybrid identity, Entra Connect, SSO, MFA, RBAC en identity provisioning. Ervaring met Azure DevOps is een pre. Je hebt ruime ervaring met PowerShell en het automatiseren van beheerprocessen binnen Microsoft 365. Je hebt ervaring met ITIL-processen, incident-, change- en releasemanagement. Je bent analytisch sterk, werkt zelfstandig en neemt eigenaarschap over complexe technische vraagstukken. Je deelt graag kennis, communiceert helder en weet collega's en belanghebbenden goed mee te nemen in technische ontwikkelingen. Je denkt vooruit, zoekt continu naar verbeteringen en draagt bij aan een veilige, stabiele en toekomstbestendige Microsoft-cloudomgeving. TU Delft Werken bij TU Delft betekent bijdragen aan oplossingen die er echt toe doen. Al meer dan 180 jaar leiden we ingenieurs op die wereldwijd impact maken bij bedrijven, overheden of als ondernemer. Onze alumni zetten kennis om in concrete oplossingen voor de uitdagingen van vandaag en morgen. Die uitdagingen veranderen snel. Daarom werken we elke dag aan thema’s zoals energie, klimaat, digitalisering, AI en slimme mobiliteit. Ons onderwijs en onderzoek sluiten direct aan op wat de samenleving nodig heeft, nu en straks. Bij TU Delft maken mensen het verschil. Met hun kennis en nieuwsgierigheid zorgen zij voor sterk onderwijs, vernieuwend onderzoek en innovaties die verder komen dan de campus. Je krijgt de ruimte om initiatief te nemen, samen te werken en jezelf te ontwikkelen. Wie bij TU Delft werkt, sluit zich aan bij een internationale community van professionals en studenten. Samen bouwen we aan kennis, innovatie en oplossingen die de wereld vooruithelpen. Universiteitsdienst – Directie ICT Bij de directie ICT werken we met circa 200 collega’s verdeeld over een aantal teams: Shared Service Center, Project Management Services, Informatiemanagement, Security, Privacy & Architectuur en Innovatie. We werken als directie ICT gezamenlijk met de faculteiten en andere directies van de TU Delft aan uiteenlopende projecten. De complexiteit en grootte van de organisatie zorgen ervoor dat ons werk vaak een uitdagende puzzel is. De grootste opdracht waar we de komende jaren als TU Delft voor staan, is het versnellen van de digitalisering om zo onze positie als universiteit van wereldklasse te versterken We werken veel samen met de specialisten op onze eigen ICT-afdeling en met onze collega’s verspreid over de universiteit. De campus is een bruisende omgeving waar altijd van alles gebeurt. De cultuur is informeel en inclusief. Er is ruimte voor een belangstellend gesprek bij de koffieautomaat en als je het leuk vindt, kun je deelnemen aan diverse activiteiten die op de campus worden georganiseerd. Bovendien krijg je binnen de directie ICT het vertrouwen en de vrijheid om je eigen werk in te delen. Er is veel mogelijk op het gebied van opleidingen en wij vinden jouw persoonlijke ontwikkeling belangrijk. Wil je meer weten over hoe het is om bij ICT te werken en zien welke vacatures er nog meer zijn? Bekijk dan hier onze werken-bij-ict pagina. Arbeidsvoorwaarden Het dienstverband is 1 jaar. Tijdelijk met uitzicht op vast. Een functieomvang van 36-40 uur per week. Een salaris dat is gebaseerd op Schaal 11 uit de CAO Nederlandse Universiteiten met salaris tussen €4925- €6682 bruto per maand op basis van een volledige werkweek (38 uur), plus 8% vakantiegeld en een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,3%. Een uitstekende pensioenregeling via het ABP. De mogelijkheid om jaarlijks een individueel arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket samen te stellen. Korting bij zorgverzekeraars op aanvullende pakketten. Flexibele werkweek. Jaarlijks 232 verlofuren (bij 38 uur). Via het individueel keuzebudget kun je bovendien verlofuren verkopen of bijkopen. Volop mogelijkheden om opleidingen, trainingen en cursussen te volgen. Gedeeltelijk doorbetaald ouderschapsverlof. Aandacht voor gezond en energiek werken met het vitaliteitsprogramma. Additionele informatie Voor meer informatie over deze vacature, neem contact op met Erwin Karselius, via E.C.Karselius@tudelft.nl. Sollicitatieprocedure Heb je interesse in deze vacature? Solliciteer dan uiterlijk 12 september 2026 via de sollicitatiebutton en upload de volgende documenten: CV Motivatiebrief Je kunt je sollicitatie richten aan Michelle Ton. Let Op Solliciteren gaat eenvoudig online. Sollicitaties die per email en/of post worden verstuurd nemen we niet in behandeling. TU Delft voert in het kader van kennisveiligheid een risicobeoordeling uit bij het werven van personeel. Dit doen wij onder meer om ongewenste overdracht van gevoelige kennis en technologie te voorkomen. De beoordeling gebeurt op basis van informatie die door kandidaat zelf is aangeleverd, zoals de motivatiebrief en het cv. De beoordeling vindt plaats bij de laatst overgebleven kandidaten in het selectieproces. Wanneer de uitkomst van de risicobeoordeling negatief is, dan wordt de kandidaat daarover geïnformeerd. De verwerking van persoonsgegevens in het kader van deze risicobeoordeling vindt plaats op basis van de wettelijke grondslag van de AVG ‘uitvoering van de publieke taak van algemeen belang’. Meer informatie over deze beoordeling vind je op onze website over kennisveiligheid. Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.
